title: `show` cyclomatic complexity 50 (134 lines)
detail: `show` (lines 263–472) has CCN=50 across 134 lines. Functions this complex require an exponential number of test cases to cover all paths and are a defect magnet. Fix: extract well-named helpers for each major decision cluster.

title: `show` has 20 parameters (line 263)
detail: `show` takes 20 parameters. Long parameter lists increase the risk of argument-order bugs and make call sites unreadable. Fix: group related parameters into a dataclass or split into smaller functions.

title: too-many-branches (R0912) — function(s) at line 263
detail: A function has more branches than pylint's threshold. High branch count multiplies test cases needed for coverage and makes the function a defect magnet. Fix: extract decision clusters into named helper functions.

title: 10× unused argument (W0613) — e.g. `show_extra_specs`, `show_extended_attr`, `show_host_status`
detail: 10 function arguments are never used within their function bodies. This often signals an interface mismatch or a method that should be `@staticmethod`. Fix: use the argument, or prefix with `_` if it's an intentionally unused interface slot.
